title: Borrow EMBEDDING string text
description: Use Cow to borrow string EMBEDDING arguments and only allocate debug fallback text for non-string values.

criteria: String EMBEDDING arguments are borrowed instead of cloned
Non-string fallback text remains the previous Debug representation

notes: Value::String returns Cow::Borrowed over the existing string bytes.
Other values return Cow::Owned with the same format!("{:?}", value) fallback text.
The embedding provider still receives &str via Cow::as_ref().
